payload.body: You tend to tolerate the group, job, or routine long after it stops fitting, then leave in a way that ends the conversation. The break protects autonomy, but it also means smaller objections were postponed until they no longer felt useful. This often comes from learning that gradual refusal would be negotiated away. State the first limit before the only satisfying option is a complete exit.
payload.astroHint: Lilith square Uranus can make a needed boundary arrive as an abrupt break.
